scripts.build: npm run minify:css && npm run minify:js
scripts.minify:css: cleancss -o src/css/styles.min.css src/css/styles.css && cleancss -o src/css/styles-faq.min.css src/css/styles-faq.css && cleancss -o src/css/main_config.min.css src/css/main_config.css && cleancss -o src/css/style_desktop.min.css src/css/style_desktop.css && cleancss -o src/css/style_mobile.min.css src/css/style_mobile.css
scripts.minify:js: terser src/js/content.js -o src/js/content.min.js -c -m && terser src/js/scripts.js -o src/js/scripts.min.js -c -m && terser src/js/visitorTracking.js -o src/js/visitorTracking.min.js -c -m && terser src/js/deviceControl.js -o src/js/deviceControl.min.js -c -m && terser src/js/animation.js -o src/js/animation.min.js -c -m
scripts.test: node tests/autorizacao.test.js && node tests/fluxo.test.js && node tests/frontend.test.js
